Game Overview

Coral Adventure puts players into a casual experience centered on embark on a vibrant underwater escapade with your Barbee fish. Tap to guide her through narrow coral mazes, dodging obstacles as you go. Challenge yourself to swim further than ever in this captivating aquatic dash. Can you master the depths and beat your high score? Dive in to find out!

How to Play

Coral Adventure keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Embark on a vibrant underwater escapade with your Barbee fish! Tap to guide her through narrow coral mazes, dodging obstacles as you go. Challenge yourself to swim further than ever in this captivating aquatic dash.
